description: This line plot illustrates the performance of two evaluation metrics—Direct Assessment Correlation and Pairwise Ranking Accuracy—as a function of the merging ratio between Direct Assessment and Pairwise Ranking, ranging from 1.9 to 9.1. The x-axis, labeled "(Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio," uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.9, spanning from 1.9 to 9.1. The y-axis on the left, labeled "Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation," is scaled linearly from 0.500 to 0.675, while the y-axis on the right, labeled "Pairwise Ranking Agreement Accuracy," is scaled linearly from 50 to 80. The plot displays three lines: a green line with circular markers representing Direct Assessment Correlation, which starts at 0.500 when the merging ratio is 1.9 and rises to a peak of 0.675 at 5.5 before declining to 0.600 at 9.1; a blue line with circular markers representing Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, which begins at approximately 0.670 at 1.9, peaks at 0.675 at 5.5, and then decreases to 0.500 at 9.1; and a black line with circular markers representing Direct Assessment Correlation, which starts at 0.575 at 1.9, rises to a peak of 0.625 at 5.5, and then declines to 0.550 at 9.1.
